import pandas as pd
import numpy as np

CATEGORY_FIX = {
    "Office Suplies": "Office Supplies",
    "Furnture": "Furniture",
}

ALLOWED_CATEGORIES = ["Electronics", "Accessories", "Furniture", "Office Supplies"]


def clean(df):
    df = df.copy()
    # Drop exact duplicate rows (keep first occurrence)
    df = df.drop_duplicates(keep="first")
    # Normalize text columns: strip whitespace
    for col in ["Category", "Region", "Product"]:
        if col in df.columns:
            df[col] = df[col].astype(str).str.strip()
            df[col] = df[col].replace({"nan": np.nan, "None": np.nan})
    # Fix category label variants
    df["Category"] = df["Category"].replace(CATEGORY_FIX)
    # Keep only valid categories
    df = df[df["Category"].isin(ALLOWED_CATEGORIES)]
    # Fix invalid (negative / zero) quantities: drop rows where Quantity < 1
    df = df[pd.to_numeric(df["Quantity"], errors="coerce") >= 1]
    # Recompute Revenue for consistency
    df["Revenue"] = df["Quantity"] * df["Price"]
    return df


def answer(df):
    df = clean(df)
    grouped = df.groupby("Category")["Price"].mean()
    return {str(k): float(v) for k, v in grouped.items()}}
